prompt: The woman at the dinner asked me what I do and I said I work in food processing which is what I always say. She asked what kind and I said large scale and she nodded and moved on. I shower twice before I feel right again and sometimes three times. Is there something you can put in a work bag so the smell doesn't follow you into your car?
